content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hi,

I hope you’re well. Before I sign the agreement, I would like to discuss a couple of clauses that need clarification.

- The relevant clause currently allows termination by the client without cause with sixty (60) days written notice, but it does not guarantee payment for work already performed. I propose that either party may terminate without cause upon sixty (60) days written notice to the other party, and that any services performed up to the termination date shall be paid in full.
- The relevant clause limits liability for indirect or consequential damages but does not set an overall cap on liability, which could leave the contractor exposed to unlimited damages. I suggest adding a cap so that the contractor’s total liability for any claim arising out of the agreement shall not exceed the total fees paid by the client, except for liability arising from gross negligence, willful misconduct, or breach of confidentiality.

Please let me know if these adjustments are acceptable. Thank you for your understanding.

Best regards
